name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Hover Card: the same speech bubble as Popover, with a tail toward the trigger, popping in.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/hover-card". It wraps your own components/ui/hover-card, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A preview in a speech bubble.
meta.usage:
import { HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/hover-card"

<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger href="#">@nightowl</HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent>Draws on Fridays.</HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
